context: Evaluates correct use of spprof's ThreadProfiler context manager for multi-threaded profiling. The candidate must use ThreadProfiler inside worker threads (not register_thread/unregister_thread directly), start the global profiler before threads are launched, and stop it after threads complete.

checklist.name: Global profiler started
checklist.description: Calls spprof.start() before launching the worker threads.

checklist.name: ThreadProfiler used in threads
checklist.description: Each worker thread uses 'with spprof.ThreadProfiler():' (or equivalent) around its workload instead of manually calling register_thread/unregister_thread.

checklist.name: Threads launched and joined
checklist.description: Creates and starts 3 threading.Thread instances with the worker function and calls join() on all of them.

checklist.name: Global profiler stopped
checklist.description: Calls spprof.stop() after all threads have been joined and captures the Profile.

checklist.name: Sample thread_id verification
checklist.description: Inspects profile.samples and verifies that samples contain thread_id values that are non-zero integers.
